checks.text: The page shows the heading "Screenshot Annotator" and a button labelled "Load image".
Clicking "Load image" loads a default test image named "sample.png" and the status text shows "Loaded: sample.png".

Clicking the tab labelled "Tools" shows a button labelled "Add text". Clicking "Add text" adds a text element with the content "Label 1" to the canvas, and the layer list shows an item "Text: Label 1".
Clicking the tab labelled "Image" shows a button labelled "Rotate 90°". Clicking "Rotate 90°" changes the status text to "Rotated: 90°".
In the "Tools" tab, clicking the button labelled "Add rectangle" adds a shape element, and the layer list shows an item "Shape: Rectangle".
In the "Image" tab, clicking the button labelled "Flip horizontal" changes the status text to "Flipped: horizontal".
Clicking the button labelled "Export PNG" triggers a file download with the name "annotated.png".
In the "Tools" tab, clicking the button labelled "Delete last" removes the most recently added layer item from the layer list.

Reload keeps the annotation state: after adding a text element "Label 1" and a shape "Rectangle", reloading the page still shows the layer list items "Text: Label 1" and "Shape: Rectangle", and the status text "Loaded: sample.png".
